## Purpose

Read installation-wide conversation health with `aq supervisor-inbox status`.
The result includes preconditions, cached Discord permissions and intent, numeric
limits, durable counts, backfill cursors/gaps, and the bounded intake ignore counter.

## When a playbook uses it

The local operator or an elevated global supervisor checks readiness before
investigating missing messages. Project-scoped sessions, workers, service principals
and playbook principals are refused by the handler.

## How it works internally

[`conversation_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/conversation_commands.py)
checks the principal, reuses the conversation preconditions and cached backfill
diagnostics, and reads counts and positions through database queries. Missing
Discord diagnostics are null; a missing ignore counter has `available: false`.

## Side effects and persistence

No database writes or Discord network calls. Counts, cursors and gaps survive a
restart; the sliding-window ignore counts do not.

## Failure modes and diagnostics

`out_of_scope` means the caller lacks global read authority. `invalid_request`
means arguments were passed to a command that takes none. Unmet preconditions
are a successful status response with `preconditions.ok: false` and named codes.

## Example step

An operator runs `aq supervisor-inbox status --json` and inspects
`data.preconditions.unmet` and `data.diagnostics` before changing configuration.
